items.exampleEn: Many animals suffer during very hot summers.
items.exampleZh: 很多動物在非常炎熱的夏天受苦。

items.exampleEn: All students have access to the library.
items.exampleZh: 所有學生都可以使用圖書館。

items.exampleEn: Don't stare at people on the train.
items.exampleZh: 在火車上不要盯著別人看。

items.exampleEn: The teacher examined each answer carefully.
items.exampleZh: 老師仔細地檢查每一個答案。

items.exampleEn: Over two hundred guests attended the wedding.
items.exampleZh: 有兩百多位賓客參加了婚禮。

items.exampleEn: How many people were involved in the plan?
items.exampleZh: 有多少人參與了這個計畫？

items.exampleEn: She pressed her face against the cold window.
items.exampleZh: 她把臉貼在冰冷的窗戶上。

items.exampleEn: Please stick the stamp on the top right corner.

items.sentenceEn: He stared out of the window for a long time.

items.audioEn: Please press the green button, and the door will open.
items.audioZh: 請按綠色的按鈕，門就會打開。
options: Wait for the door to open.

items.sentenceEn: I can't attend the party because I have to work late.
items.sentenceZh: 我不能參加派對，因為我得加班。

items.sentenceEn: Write your name on a note and stick it on your lunch box.
items.sentenceZh: 把名字寫在便條紙上，貼在你的便當盒上。

items.stemEn: Before you buy a used car, you should ____ it carefully.
items.stemZh: 買二手車之前，你應該仔細檢查。

items.stemEn: Our sales ____ a lot when the shop next door opened.
items.stemZh: 隔壁的店開張後，我們的銷售大受影響。

items.passageEn: Ms. Lee works at a big hotel. Last week, she attended a meeting about a new door system. Soon, guests will open their doors with their phones, so they will not need a key. Only guests will have access to the upper floors. Ms. Lee was involved in testing the system. She examined every door and stuck a small sign next to each one. The sign says, "Press your phone here." At first, some guests stared at the doors for a long time, but they learned quickly.
items.passageZh: 李小姐在一家大飯店工作。上星期，她參加了一場關於新門禁系統的會議。很快地，房客將用手機開房門，不再需要鑰匙。只有房客能進入樓上的樓層。李小姐參與了系統的測試。她檢查了每一扇門，並在每扇門旁邊貼了一張小告示，上面寫著：「把手機按在這裡。」一開始，有些房客盯著門看了很久，但他們很快就學會了。

questions.questionZh: 李小姐在新系統中負責什麼？
誰可以進入飯店樓上的樓層？

items.promptZh: 我們每個人都必須出席星期五的會議。
referenceEn: All of us must attend the meeting on Friday.
Each of us has to attend Friday's meeting.
rubricZh: attend 後面直接接活動，不加 to（例如 attend the meeting）
主詞用 each of us 時動詞用單數（例如 has to）

items.instructionZh: 用 stick 造一個句子，說說你會把什麼東西貼在哪裡。
referenceEn: I stick notes on my computer screen.
I always stick photos of my family on the fridge.
rubricZh: stick 表示「黏貼」，常用 stick A on B（例如 stick notes on the screen）
說習慣多用現在簡單式，其他合理時態也接受
